card.name: Leading digit in converted number in parentheses
card.fires_on: A digit inside a number written in parentheses as a unit conversion, such as (45 cm), (20 mCi) or (30 mCi). It fires on the first or second digit, before a trailing 0 or 5 is expected.

modes.description: A digit of the bracketed equivalent measure after a main measure, as in inches to cm or MBq to mCi.
